text: The menuz menu reads Discover, which runs arngz auto --default, and Save Desk..., whose parameter default stays arngz current rather than arngz which. It is Molt-matts configuration, not a Utilz file, and it lands only after the arngz change is live on the machine.

state.evidence: Molt-matts b340832 (pushed): config/menuz/menuz.yaml reads Discover, which runs 'arngz auto --default rhad', and Save Desk..., whose desk default is $(arngz current || echo today). hv deployed it to ~/.config/menuz/menuz.yaml (cmp-equal) on Menuz 0.4.10 with utilz 2.14.10 (arngz 1.2.1) from brew. hv, 10 Nov, first-hand in vc's session: 'Discover worked.'
